fix_message: fix(p2-fe/frontend): adapt MacroSnapshot.signals to keyed-object contract (architect ruling 1d277bc7)

files_changed.change: Removed MacroSignal interface and MacroSnapshot.signals: MacroSignal[]. Added MacroSignalEntry (heterogeneous optional fields covering all 6 signal kinds) and MacroSignals = Record<string, MacroSignalEntry>. Updated MacroSnapshot.signals to type MacroSignals.

MacroSignalPanel: replaced snapshot.signals.map() with Object.entries(snapshot.signals).map([key, entry]). InfoSourcePanel: replaced .length and spread+.sort() with Object.values/Object.entries equivalents. indicatorLabel(): added 6 canonical key mappings (oil, gold, usdvnd, investment-clock, carry, yield). Import: MacroSignal → MacroSignalEntry.

Appended describe('MacroSnapshot signals — keyed-object contract') with 4 assertions: signals is object not array, Object.entries gives 6 keys, per-key field access (oil.impact, oil.priceUSD), Object.values length === 6.

verify_gates.vitest: 183/183 passed (179 existing + 4 new contract assertions). GREEN.
verify_gates.tsc_noEmit: exit 0. Clean. All consumers of MacroSnapshot.signals compile with keyed-object type.
verify_gates.lint_fence: exit 0. No violations. Deprecation warnings only (pre-existing, non-fatal).
verify_gates.remix_build: vite 114 modules + SSR 21 modules. Built in 2.39s + 171ms. No errors.

rationale: Macro-indicators Go service (CLOSED pilot, commit 3e4a00c4) defines signals as SignalResult struct — keyed JSON object. Frontend array expectation was stale. Fix is entirely in apps/frontend/ only. Macro container image 91c1184d unchanged.
